      "name": "utils",

      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,

      "rationale": "Non-member. Node initialization adjustments follow the validation architecture change."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Massively refactors chainstate management across src/validation.cpp, src/node/chainstate.cpp, and src/txdb.cpp to remove concurrent chainstates.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.68,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Addresses the severe architectural overhead and synchronization complexity imposed on core validation by multi-chainstate infrastructure. The author notes that 'Multiple chainstates affect much more than snapshot loading: ordinary validation changes have to account for different chainstate roles, candidate sets, notifications, downloads, pruning, cache allocation, database lifetimes and locks,' representing a significant recurring maintenance burden."
    },
